programme.desc: 'S2/E312'. A braai brings the vibes and community together, but then a dark cloud forms over Soebatskloof.

programme.title: Skree Dit Uit!
programme.desc: 'S1/E19'. Kanat admits to Ekim that he's leaving school and reveals his true feelings for her. Aziz then exposes the family's secret with devastating consequences.

programme.title: Yosef
programme.desc: 'S2/E33'. Duygu is devastated and tells Ali what happened that fateful day. Seher is determined that everyone remembers Kevser for the person she was.

programme.title: Kelders Van Geheime
programme.desc: 'S2/E313'. Matthew and Brenda can no longer deny their feelings for one another. Shireen's assistance is called for, and the news spread over Soebatskloof. Joey is especially affected by this new tragedy.

programme.title: Een Wit Leuen
programme.desc: 'S1/E46'. Saniye and Rafet move out of Sevket's house. Suna loses Kayra and unsuspectingly meets Aylin. Nejat takes Suna out and promises her dreams might come true. Will Adre own up?

programme.title: Maanligsprokie
programme.desc: 'S1/E62'. Ferman's lies and secrets are quickly catching up to him, as are Mahir's. Savas finds himself a pawn in several players' game plans. Selim goes to report Ceylan - where is she?

programme.title: Bloedspoor
programme.desc: 'S2/E69'. A death among the friends has different effects on different people. Defne struggles to adjust after her ordeal. Omer gives Ceylin evidence to help Ilgaz with his investigation.

programme.title: Fenix
programme.desc: 'S1/E49'. Celebi uses his biggest secret to get ahead in his career. Gunes chooses to stay with her mother. Can Cemre give her the life she's used to?
